title: RightsScope - entitlement scope with explicit currentness (fail-closed)
description: Shape of a RightsScope (see src/security/rights.py). This is a SHAPE check only; passing it is not an acceptance and never authorizes an action. The currentness law is enforced in src/security/rights.py and is NOT expressible in JSON Schema because it is a decision law, not a shape law: a scope whose expires_at is non-null CANNOT be evaluated without a trusted `now` supplied by the caller. An omitted or malformed `now` is unknown currentness and DENIES with CURRENTNESS_UNAVAILABLE_FAIL_CLOSED before any entitlement is consulted. Equality at the expiry instant (now == expires_at) is EXPIRED. A scope with expires_at null has nothing to evaluate and is not made expired by an absent `now`. The library never reads the wall clock; `now` is an explicit trusted input.

expires_at.description: ISO-8601 UTC instant, or null for no expiry. When non-null the runtime requires a trusted `now`: check_rights / assert_credential_scope fail closed (CURRENTNESS_UNAVAILABLE_FAIL_CLOSED) if `now` is omitted, an unparsable `expires_at` is treated as expired, and `now >= expires_at` (equality included) is expired. currentness_required(scope) is True exactly when this field is non-null.
